title: Recent Advances in Deep Learning-Based Drug-Target Binding Affinity Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.13797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational approaches to drug discovery involve multiple sub-problems, and among them, drug-target binding affinity prediction plays an important role. Despite recent advances, accurately predicting binding affinity remains an open research area. The major objective of our paper is to perform a comprehensive review and comparative analysis of recent machine learning methods for drug-target binding affinity prediction, with a focus on identifying strengths, limitations, and research gaps. We review representative recent deep learning approaches that use common benchmark datasets and evaluation metrics, covering a range of neural network architectures and representation strategies. In addition, we analyze seven widely used benchmark datasets and commonly adopted evaluation metrics for drug-target binding affinity prediction. translated_title: 基于深度学习的药物-靶点结合亲和力预测的最新进展
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13797v1 公告类型：新 摘要：计算药物发现方法涉及多个子问题，其中药物-靶点结合亲和力预测扮演着重要角色。尽管近期有所进展，但准确预测结合亲和力仍是一个开放的研究领域。我们论文的主要目标是对近期用于药物-靶点结合亲和力预测的机器学习方法进行全面综述和比较分析，重点识别其优势、局限性和研究空白。我们回顾了使用常见基准数据集和评估指标的近期代表性深度学习方法，涵盖了一系列神经网络架构和表示策略。此外，我们分析了七个广泛使用的基准数据集和常用的评估指标，用于药物-靶点结合亲和力预测。我们的分析表明，尽管许多方法在标准基准上报告了强劲的性能，但其有效性……
tldr: 本文综述了基于深度学习的药物-靶点结合亲和力预测方法，比较了常见基准和指标，指出虽有性能优势但存在有效性和研究空白。
en_tdlr: This paper reviews deep learning methods for drug-target binding affinity prediction, comparing common benchmarks and metrics, and notes performance strengths but also effectiveness gaps and research limitations.
